data.summary_en: We propose MMPostTrainBench (multimodal post-training benchmark) and MMResearch linking media evidence to hypotheses/interventions; hierarchical memory passes findings across rounds; dev evaluation retains candidates; with existing code-agent runtimes, submitted model accuracy improves up to 7.75 percentage points (Claude Opus 4.8+Claude Code) and 2.33 percentage points (GPT-5.6-sol+Codex).
